notes: Raw snapshots of the UC Berkeley Schedule of Classes (classes.berkeley.edu), trimmed of scripts, styles, images and navigation chrome. No content values were edited.
Detail pages: /content/<section-slug>, which list a lecture's associated discussion/lab sections.
Enrollment numbers and open seats are what the site showed on the fetch date; discussion sections listed with Enrollment Limit 0 or 1 are placeholders the department had not opened yet.
